entries.name: VSH Veterinary Specialty Hospital Aruba
entries.address: 9 Caya Ernesto Petronia 88, Ponton, Oranjestad, Aruba
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:00-18:00, Sat 9:00-13:00, Sun closed. Emergency care outside regular hours; call or WhatsApp +297 699 0077.
entries.note: Re-verified 2026-11-16: page shows '24/7 Emergency' in header/feature tags, but the Hours section only says emergencies are 'Available outside regular hours' (ambiguous, not explicit round-the-clock), so emergency_24h set to false; phone confirmation advisable. WhatsApp +297 699 0077.

notes: Only two clinics could be verified on opened pages. Unreachable/refused: vsharuba.com/contact and /service-page/urgent-care (client_error), acc-aruba.com mirror on madurologisticsaruba.com (robots), acc-aruba.com/acc-aruba/ANIMAL_CARE_CLINIC.html (empty content), Facebook pages for Animal Care Clinic (Paradera 177 A) and VSH (robots). Animal Care Clinic Aruba and Veterinaire Kliniek Wayaca (128 Wayaca, Oranjestad, seen only on an aggregator without contact data) exist per search but were not verifiable, so omitted. Government Veterinary Service (DVG VET, Barcadera 1, Oranjestad, +297 585 0400, vetservice@dvg.aw) is a regulatory service, not a clinic, so not an entry. No duty rota or animal poison line found for Aruba.
